brief: A storage box whose lid is held shut with magnets.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Hex base piece:0,0,0;full forms walls, closed on 6 sides by caps (cap:0,0,0;*;30/90/150/210/270/330), contains hex-bin-full bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full providing ~142x124mm storage floor (77mm deep) – functions as an enclosed storage box. 220x89x218mm overall.

Cover cover:0,0,0;full;top (type solid) closes the top face. Covers contain integral magnets by default – verified by setCoverMagnets returning ALREADY_FITTED/NO_CHANGE 'cover already has its magnets in'. Lid therefore is magnetically retained shut on the box rim.

finish.summary: Built a single-cell enclosed storage box: Full hex base with 6 solid caps, full bin inside for storage, and a Full solid top cover as lid. The lid is the standard magnetic cover – magnets are factory-fitted (confirmed by configurator response) so it is held shut magnetically. Build passes checks with meshClash clear.
